tasks.description: Independently designed, built, and launched a full-stack SaaS productivity web application (Typescript, Next.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Firebase Auth, Stripe) for task tracking and journaling. Successfully implemented 14-day trials and subscription billing, deploying on Vercel and Render.

Developed a frontend-only contract pricing platform featuring dynamic cost calculations and PDF generation. Leveraged Session Storage for efficient temporary data management, ensuring a smooth user experience.

Built a solo web app to generate dynamic contract quotes based on user input, using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Context API, deployed on Vercel using sessionStorage for lightweight state management.
